battles.title: Great Swamp Fight
battles.summary: Major assault on a Narragansett stronghold in the Great Swamp (modern Rhode Island). Colonial forces attacked a winter encampment; casualties and long-term diplomatic fallout were severe.

battles.title: Bloody Brook
battles.summary: Ambush near a cart path in the Connecticut River valley as colonial troops escorted grain; emblematic of frontier raids and counter-raids.

battles.title: Brookfield siege
battles.summary: Settlement under attack and relief column actions in central Massachusetts during the opening phase of the war.

battles.title: Turner's Falls / Peskeompskut
battles.summary: Raid on an Indigenous fishing encampment on the Connecticut River; often paired with Metacom’s War narratives about retaliation cycles.

battles.title: Lancaster raid
battles.summary: Attack on the Lancaster settlement during the winter campaign period; often cited in captivity and frontier defense narratives.
belligerents: Native war parties aligned against English expansion

battles.title: Sudbury Fight
battles.summary: Major engagement near Sudbury where relief columns and local forces were heavily hit in a broad ambush and running fight.

battles.title: Mount Hope campaign
battles.summary: Operations around Mount Hope and nearby swamps culminating in Metacom’s death; used as a symbolic endpoint in many narratives.

battles.title: Lexington and Concord
battles.summary: Opening armed engagements of the war in Massachusetts; militia and British regulars clashed on the road network west of Boston.

battles.title: Bunker Hill
battles.summary: Early pitched battle for heights overlooking Boston; showed colonial forces could stand against regulars despite British tactical success.

battles.title: Saratoga campaign
battles.summary: Northern campaign often treated as a turning point encouraging French alliance; involved Continental and state troops against a British northern army.

battles.title: Siege of Yorktown
battles.summary: Franco-American siege that trapped a British field army; French fleet and ground forces were decisive alongside Continentals.

battles.title: Trenton
battles.summary: Continental crossing and surprise attack at Trenton during the New Jersey campaign, often paired with Princeton in winter operations.

battles.title: Princeton
battles.summary: Follow-on engagement after Trenton that helped recover Continental momentum and shifted pressure in New Jersey.

battles.title: Monmouth
battles.summary: Large late-June battle in extreme heat during the British withdrawal from Philadelphia to New York.
